item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera keeps a small glass tank at home in Pune. Inside the tank are six guppy fish of one kind, some water plants, snails, sand, and water. A biologist notes down everything in the tank, including the living organisms and the non-living parts, along with how they interact.

What is the best description of everything inside the tank?

options.A: a population, because the guppies are one kind of organism living together
options.B: a community, because it contains several kinds of living organisms
options.C: an ecosystem, because it includes different living organisms interacting with non-living parts
options.D: a habitat, because the tank provides shelter for the fish
